items.title: elayadesign/ai-design-skills
items.summary: elayadesign/ai-design-skills offers a collection of design skills consisting of markdown rule files that AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf) can read. This project provides a guide-like resource for AI-powered tools to standardize design processes.

snapshot.description: A growing collection of design skills for AI coding tools — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, and anything else that reads a markdown rules file.

items.title: Ghostty 1.4
items.summary: Ghostty 1.4 is a new version update released for the terminal emulator Ghostty. It includes various bug fixes and improvements that enhance the software's performance and user experience.

items.title: Genie 4
items.summary: Genie 4, developed by DeepMind, represents a new generation in world simulation technology. This model stands out for its capacity to create interactive and dynamic environments from visual data.

items.title: New iMac with M6
items.summary: Apple has announced the new iMac model equipped with the M6 chip. The desktop computer has been updated for daily use and professional workflows with its high-performance processor.

items.title: Benchmarking Obstacle-Conditioned Safety in Household Robot Navigation
items.summary: The article shared by Hugging Face introduces an evaluation system called OSMA-Bench that measures safe movement adaptation based on obstacles in indoor robot navigation. The study proposes a new method called the Semantic Sensitivity Index to measure the ability of robots to adjust speed and distance according to object type and distance.

snapshot.description: Safe household navigation requires robots to regulate clearance and speed according to what an obstacle is and how close it is, without unnecessary conservatism. Yet existing evaluations do not test whether semantic safety distinctions are reflected in continuous motion. items.title: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
items.summary: The Trinity, released on Hugging Face, presents a capability-focused recursive self-improvement method for multimodal artificial intelligence agents. The study aims to overcome scaling barriers such as the cost of creating heterogeneous environments and the slowness of manual iteration processes.

snapshot.description: Multimodal intelligence can be viewed as human-guided co-evolution between worlds and agents through interaction. items.title: PhysEvolve: Verifier-grounded Self-evolution for Physical Reasoning with Executable Worlds
items.summary: PhysEvolve is a method designed to address reliability issues that vision-language models experience in physical reasoning processes. It aims to bridge gaps in physical causality by using a self-evolving paradigm that allows the model to generate its own training data.

snapshot.description: Physical reasoning underpins how embodied systems understand and act in the physical world, yet vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable on questions about dynamics and physical causality. Progress is critically constrained by the scarcity of grounded counterfactual training data, as observational videos capture only the factual trajectory that occurred. items.title: MoveBench: A Rubric-Based Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Sports and Health Coaching
items.summary: MoveBench is a rubric-based benchmarking tool developed to evaluate the performance of large language models (LLMs) in the fields of sports and health coaching. Unlike general-purpose tests, it offers specialized measurement in critical areas such as exercise safety, physiological suitability, and personalization.

snapshot.description: Despite rapid advances in large language models (LLMs), their deployment in the sports and health domain remains high-risk due to the absence of domain-specific evaluation benchmarks. items.title: MLE-World: Predicting Machine Learning Experiment Outcomes with a Learned World Model
items.summary: MLE-World, shared by Hugging Face, is a world model that predicts the results of machine learning experiments based on code and data descriptions. Fine-tuned based on Qwen3.5-4B, this system enables AI agents to work more efficiently by predicting error logs and validation scores without the need to train and run the models.

snapshot.description: AI research agents can propose, execute, and improve programs that solve machine learning tasks.
